verdict.rationale: Buzz ships its own agent runtime (buzz-agent) and a Desktop-bundled managed agent. Users delegate work by @mentioning agents inside channels; the agents act through the Buzz CLI to open repos, send patches, run workflows and edit canvases, and users steer or stop them in-chat. Community skepticism ("bots in chat rooms") confirms the agents exist rather than contradicting the capability. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably, and clarity that the built-in assistant works without the user configuring an external LLM provider or agent harness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
